automation_evidence.quote: GridMind, a multi-agent AI system that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) with deterministic engineering solvers to enable conversational scientific computing for power system analysis.

summary: GridMind lets LLM agents drive ACOPF and N-1 contingency solvers through natural language; evaluation reports success rate and latency across LLMs on static IEEE cases, with no baseline score gain or temporal obstacle tested.
